title: Grow up!
description: A datapack that makes you start smaller so you can get taller over time, just like in real life!
body:
## What do you mean it makes me grow up?
Your character will start at around 1.65m (5'5") and will slowly grow to a random height between 1.65m (5'5") and 2.10m (6'11") over the span of 24 real-life hours. You basically age!

This datapack changes your pehkui:base size, which means that your stats will slightly change too, it isn't only visual.
  
Everything is customizable through commands as detailed below.
  
After changing the config, run `/function grow_up:init` to apply them and re run everything

## Config (click for more details)
<details>
  <summary>
    /scoreboard players set global adtmylgu.starting_size <pehkui scale * 100 000 000>
  </summary>
  For example /scoreboard players set global adtmylgu.minimum_size 90000000 corresponds to a default scale of 0.90 for Pehkui (and is the default value).
</details>
<details>
  <summary>
    /scoreboard players set global adtmylgu.minimum_size <pehkui scale * 100 000 000>
  </summary>
  For example /scoreboard players set global adtmylgu.minimum_size 94000000 corresponds to a minimum scale of 0.94 for Pehkui (and is the default minimum value).
</details>
<details>
  <summary>
    /scoreboard players set global adtmylgu.maximum_size <pehkui scale * 100 000 000>
  </summary>
  For example /scoreboard players set global adtmylgu.maximum_size 110000000 corresponds to a maximum scale of 1.1 for Pehkui (and is the default maximum value).
</details>
<details>
  <summary>
    /scoreboard players set global adtmylgu.duration <number of seconds>
  </summary>
  For example /scoreboard players set global adtmylgu.duration 86400 will make the player reach it's final height in 86400s (which is equivalent to 24h, the default value).
</details>

Enjoy :)
